subject: Next steps to confirm budget owner & procurement path — DataQuarry pilot
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Carter <evan.carter@datquarry.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 May 2025 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps to confirm budget owner & procurement path — DataQuarry pilot
Attachments: MQP_MAP_v1.xlsx (Mutual Action Plan draft)

Hi Evan —

Thanks again for the demo today — really appreciated the quick walkthrough of the ingestion pipeline and the use cases you highlighted for QA and cohorting. Short recap so we have alignment: 

- Goal: run a 6-week pilot to validate latency/throughput at 1–2M tokens/day and evaluate model quality on your customer support corpus.
- Success criteria you mentioned: response latency < 200ms p50, cost target under $0.12/1k tokens, and an initial quality check on intent detection > 90% F1.
- Dependencies: access to a representative dataset sample + procurement/security clearance.

Two quick asks to keep momentum: 
1) Can you confirm who will be signing off on budget for the pilot? If Maya Singh (VP Finance) is the right person, would you be willing to intro us? We want a 10–15 minute alignment with her to set expectations on cost and timelines.
2) Who owns procurement/security intake (questionnaires, SOC2 evidence)? If you can share the contact or the standard intake form, we’ll prepare our packet.

I attached a one-page Mutual Action Plan (MQP_MAP_v1.xlsx) with a suggested timeline and owners — nothing final, just to help the stakeholders. Proposed next meetings: 
- Option A: 20-min budget calibration with budget owner + Heitor/Hector from procurement (quick commercial alignment).
- Option B: 45-min technical + procurement session (if they want to review data/security details).

Suggested slots (PST): Thu 5/15 3:00–3:30pm, Fri 5/16 10:00–10:45am, or Mon 5/19 1:00–1:30pm. If none work, send preferred times and we’ll adapt.

Thanks — I’ll loop Ben (pricing/procurement lead) and Monica (CS lead) so they can jump in with technical/contract items.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

--
Redwood Inference | Production-first inference for LLMs
From: Evan Carter <evan.carter@datquarry.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hector Ruiz <hector.ruiz@datquarry.com>, Maya Singh <m.singh@datquarry.com>
Date: Thu, 15 May 2025 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Next steps to confirm budget owner & procurement path — DataQuarry pilot
Attachments: DataQuarry_RFP_schedule.docx

Thanks Soojin — great summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Budget owner: likely Maya Singh (VP Finance). I copied her and Hector (procurement). Maya, Soojin/Redwood have put together a pilot plan; a 10–15 minute alignment to confirm commercial ceilings would be helpful.
- Procurement/security intake: Hector runs procurement; he’ll want our standard intake (we typically accept SOC2 and a short security questionnaire). I’m attaching our RFP schedule so you can see timing constraints.
- Legal: we route NDAs/standard SOWs to legal@datquarry.com — they usually take ~5–7 business days for a pilot SOW.

Preferred times for Maya/Hector: Fri 5/16 after 2pm ET or Mon 5/19 between 11am–2pm ET. If that works for Redwood, let’s lock one.

Also, FYI: Maya is focused on showing a clear ROI for the pilot — she’ll want an upfront cost envelope and a clear gating criterion for moving to full deployment. Happy to handle the intro if you provide a one-pager and proposed slot.

Cheers,
Evan Carter
Head of Product Operations, DataQuarry
evan.carter@datquarry.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Singh <m.singh@datquarry.com>, Evan Carter <evan.carter@datquarry.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Hector Ruiz <hector.ruiz@datquarry.com>
Date: Fri, 16 May 2025 09:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps to confirm budget owner & procurement path — DataQuarry pilot
Attachments: (none)

Maya / Evan — thanks for the quick response and for looping Maya and Hector. Maya — welcome, glad to meet you by email. Short proposal for next steps so we don’t block on scheduling: 

1) Intro/Calibration (10–15m): confirm the pilot budget envelope and gating criteria. Suggested slots (ET): Fri 5/16 3:30–3:45pm ET or Mon 5/19 11:30–11:45am ET. If either works indicate which and I’ll send a calendar invite with a one-page cost/goal summary.
2) Procurement intake: Hector — if you have a standard security questionnaire or vendor intake, could you attach it or point us to the form? We’ll return SOC2 and an executive security summary within 48 hours.
3) PO vs. SOW: as a quick heads-up, our pilot options are typically handled by a short SOW (pilot scope + acceptance) or a PO for customers preferring not to execute a SOW. Either is fine — Ben is copied to advise on the easiest path for DataQuarry.

Ben / Monica — we’ll need the SOC2 summary and a pilot estimate one-pager (I’ve flagged the HubSpot deal). Ben, could you drop the estimate and a suggested commercial envelope for a 6-week, 2M tokens/day pilot?

Thanks — happy to be flexible on cadence; priority is a short touch with Maya to confirm commercial constraints.

Best,
Soojin

Hi Evan / Maya — Ben here (pricing & procurement at Redwood). Quick notes to unblock scheduling: 

- Attached is a short SOC2 summary and a 1-sheet pilot estimate. For a 6-week pilot at ~2M tokens/day, rough commercial envelope is $18k–$26k depending on batching/quantization profile; we can tighten this after we see the token distribution.
- We can proceed on either a short SOW or a PO. If your legal prefers PO, we can accept that and attach the SOW as an appendix to keep scope clear.
- For procurement: we’ll also provide an editable security questionnaire (I’ve uploaded a canonical packet to the Drive link Soojin shared).

Maya — if you’d like, I can join the 10–15 minute calibration to walk budget assumptions. Suggested slot: Mon 5/19 11:30–11:45am ET (will hold tentatively).

Thanks — happy to adapt.

Ben Carter
